description: This file contains functions related to reading and manipulating boot configuration data from a device-specific file. It defines methods to validate magic numbers, retrieve partition information, set primary boot flags, and toggle primary boot status for device partitions.

methods.name: validate_bootconfig_magic
methods.description: Checks the magic numbers at the start and end of the boot configuration file to verify its validity.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_numparts
methods.description: Reads the number of partitions from the boot configuration file.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_partidx
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a partition given its name by scanning the partition entries.

methods.name: get_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Gets the primary boot flag (0 or 1) for a specified partition.

methods.name: _set_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Internal function to set the primary boot flag for a partition.

methods.name: set_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Sets the primary boot flag (0 or 1) for a specified partition after validation.

methods.name: toggle_bootconfig_primaryboot
methods.description: Toggles the primary boot flag between 0 and 1 for a specified partition.
